MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper fits my electronics projects because I could use it to measure circuit boards, components, and mounting clearances.",
    "A practical measuring tool connects naturally to my past purchases of prototyping parts and a temperature-measuring tool."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The filament assumes a current 3D printing need that my electronics and hardware purchases do not establish.",
    "Different filament colors and shiny finishes do not solve a task I currently have.",
    "The locking nuts are potentially useful, but I need matching bolt sizes and a specific mounting task before an assortment becomes a worthwhile purchase."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in making and repairing things seems to have been stretched into an interest in 3D printing supplies.",
    "The many filament options assume that choosing a material or color matters to me before there is evidence that I need filament at all."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, relay, PCB supplies, and battery holder point toward assembling and connecting electronic components.",
    "I choose supplies when they serve a concrete task; general usefulness alone is not enough.",
    "For hardware, dimensions and compatibility with the parts I am using matter more than simply belonging to the broader world of DIY projects."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical DIY interests but mostly mistook electronics prototyping for a current need for 3D printing materials."
}
